description: The Domain Name System translates human-readable domain names to machine-readable IP addresses.
real_world_incidents: Open DNS resolvers abused for massive DDoS amplification attacks against internet infrastructure.
recommended_actions: Restrict Zone Transfers (AXFR) to trusted IPs.
Disable recursive queries for external clients (close the open resolver).

audience_guidance.student: DNS is the phonebook of the internet. If misconfigured, an attacker can ask for the 'whole phonebook' (zone transfer) and see all hidden servers.
audience_guidance.developer: Ensure your DNS server (e.g., BIND) only allows AXFR transfers to secondary nameservers. Disable recursion for untrusted IPs.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Attempt a zone transfer (dig axfr @server domain). Look for hidden subdomains and internal hostnames.
audience_guidance.pentester: Test for AXFR. Check if the server acts as an open resolver for DDoS amplification.
audience_guidance.security_team: Monitor for AXFR requests from untrusted IPs. Scan external footprint for open resolvers.
